title: Restore Version 42 design, logo, and music player functionality

requirements.text: Restore the website logo display to match Version 42 exactly, ensuring it appears in the Header component with correct positioning, sizing, and visibility
acceptanceCriteria: Logo is visible in the header
Logo matches the appearance from Version 42
Logo displays correctly on both desktop and mobile views

requirements.text: Restore the MusicPlayer component functionality exactly as it existed in Version 42, including play/pause controls, volume slider, mute toggle, and background music playback
acceptanceCriteria: Music player is visible and functional
Volume controls (slider and mute) operate as expected
Music playback state persists as in Version 42

requirements.text: Revert all visual design changes introduced in Version 43 and restore the complete design system from Version 42, including colors, typography, layout, spacing, gradients, and component styling across all pages

quotes: the design of the website has been changed, and it's still changed, like it hasn't gone back to the way I asked for it to

acceptanceCriteria: All pages match Version 42 visual appearance
Layout and component styling match Version 42
No visual remnants of Version 43 changes remain

requirements.text: Compare Version 44 against Version 42 as the authoritative baseline to identify and revert any discrepancies in frontend files, including CSS, component structure, and configuration

quotes: Version 43 was the one that changed the website. Version 42 is where you get back the website the way it was

acceptanceCriteria: All frontend files match Version 42 state
CSS and styling files restored to Version 42
Component files restored to Version 42 structure
No unintended changes from Version 43 or 44 remain

constraints: Use Version 42 as the exact reference point for all restorations
Do not introduce any new features or changes beyond restoring Version 42 state
nonGoals: Modifying backend logic or data structures
Implementing design improvements beyond Version 42 state
